maya: Heads-up — after the tokenization fix that avoided invalid utf-8 hits, we're seeing a 10-15% p99 regression on Mixtral-7B in staging. Repro steps below.

aj: ugh. what changed exactly in the tokenizer? byte fallback logic? :grimacing:

maya: yes — previously we fell back to byte-level only for weird bytes; patch now does broader byte-fallback for some special tokens. diff is small but perf moved.

eli: can you paste the perf numbers? p50/p95/p99 and an allocation trace if available.

maya: quick smoke from staging (seq=512, batch=8):
```
model: mixtral-7b
baseline (old-tokenizer): p50=42ms p95=98ms p99=132ms
new-tokenizer: p50=44ms p95=110ms p99=151ms
memory: +120MB transient during decode
```

zoe: that memory blip smells like KV cache reallocation or extra copy during decode. did the tokenizer change increase avg token count? more byte tokens -> longer sequence length?

maya: yes, token counts up by ~6% on average for our chat templates (BOS/EOS + role markers). sample: 512 -> 543 tokens effective for many shards.

aj: If effective seq grows, kernel selection might switch to a less-optimized path for attention or einsum. Are we falling back from fused-attn to generic kernel?

eli: I profiled kernels. Trace shows fallback to the non-fused RoPE scaling kernel when seq > 512 for certain heads/kv dims. Kernel chooser uses heuristic: if seq*heads*kv_dim > threshold -> choose fallback. The tokenizer bump pushed us over threshold for several requests.

maya: here's the kernel decision log snip from the runtime: 
```
[kernel-chooser] model=mixtral-7b seq=543 heads=32 kv_dim=64 est_ops=110M -> selected=attn_generic_v2 (not attn_fused_v1)
```

aj: ok that explains the latency. Two vectors: 1) reduce token count by normalizing chat templates (trim extra spaces/special role tokens), 2) adjust kernel thresholds or add a middle-ground kernel.

zoe: also check quantization layout — some quant kernels expect 64-bit KV stride; if byte fallback changes tokenization, we might be hitting a path that misaligns cache-friendly layout and causes extra memcpy.

eli: good call. I saw extra memcpy in decode hotpath in the trace: 
```
memcpy 1.2ms x N (hot)
kv_realloc 8.4ms (occurs on first token after seq growth)
```

maya: perf-bot posted the full flamegraph: <https://perf.internal/trace/1771003456>

perf-bot: Automated regression alert: p99 increased 14% for mixtral-7b on staging; suspected causes: tokenizer-byte-fallback, kernel-chooser threshold crossing. See trace: https://perf.internal/trace/1771003456 :robot_face:

aj: immediate mitigation: can we revert the tokenizer patch to narrower fallback and roll a targeted fix for only the malformed-utf8 cases? That should lower avg token counts back to baseline.

maya: we can, but the broader fallback actually fixed a couple customer edge cases (emoji sequences). Need to balance.

zoe: short-term config option: add runtime flag to force kernel_chooser.threshold += 20% for Mixtral models to keep fused-attn selected until we ship a patch. Long-term: implement a middle fused kernel variant for seq between 512-600.

eli: also need to test RoPE scaling interaction: earlier RoPE scaling patch changed rotary exponent table layout which probably makes the generic kernel slower for this model. If we tune rope scale per-head dims (heads/kv split), we might avoid the heavy path.

aj: action items: 
- maya: run tokenizer ablation to quantify token count delta per template (deadline EOD).
- eli: run microbench with kernel_chooser thresholds +/-10/20% and see p99 sensitivity (deadline tomorrow AM).
- zoe: prototype runtime flag and a safe canary (dedicated capacity) to flip for mixtral (drop-in config) (tomorrow).
- maya/aj: decide on revert vs narrower fix after results.

maya: quick reproduction command for CI perf job: 
```
./runtimes/bench --model mixtral-7b --tokenizer new-fallback --batch 8 --seq 512 --iters 500 --report p50,p95,p99,mem
```

eli: note: also test with qkv-layout=interleaved vs blocked; blocked layout helped in previous cases when memcpy dominated.

zoe: pinging infra to reserve a dedicated GPU node for the canary (cc @infra).

maya: thanks team. i'll drop the tokenizer ablation results in this thread when ready. cc perf-bot for continuous monitoring. :thumbsup:
